name: princeprocessor
summary: Standalone password candidate generator using the PRINCE algorithm.
highlights: --pw-min — Print candidate if length is greater than NUM
--pw-max — Print candidate if length is smaller than NUM
--elem-cnt-min — Minimum number of elements per chain
--elem-cnt-max — Maximum number of elements per chain
--wl-dist-len — Calculate output length distribution from wordlist
--wl-max — Load only NUM words from input wordlist or use 0 to disable
-c — Disable dupes check for faster initial load

flags.name: --pw-min
flags.description: Print candidate if length is greater than NUM

flags.name: --pw-max
flags.description: Print candidate if length is smaller than NUM

flags.name: --elem-cnt-min
flags.description: Minimum number of elements per chain

flags.name: --elem-cnt-max
flags.description: Maximum number of elements per chain

flags.name: --wl-dist-len
flags.description: Calculate output length distribution from wordlist

flags.name: --wl-max
flags.description: Load only NUM words from input wordlist or use 0 to disable

flags.name: --dupe-check-disable
flags.description: Disable dupes check for faster initial load

flags.name: --save-pos-disable
flags.description: Save the position for later resume with -s

flags.name: --skip
flags.description: Skip NUM passwords from start (for distributed)

flags.name: --limit
flags.description: Limit output to NUM passwords (for distributed)

flags.name: --case-permute
flags.description: For each word in the wordlist that begins with a letter generate a word with the opposite case of the first letter
